mapper.select: insert into auth_sessions ( user_id, refresh_token_hash, device_name, ip_address, user_agent, expires_at ) values ( cast(#{userId} as uuid), #{refreshTokenHash}, #{deviceName}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{expiresAt} ) returning id::text
select id::text as id, user_id::text as user_id, refresh_token_hash, is_active as active, expires_at from auth_sessions where id = cast(#{sessionId} as uuid) and is_active = true limit 1
mapper.update: update auth_sessions set is_active = false, updated_at = now() where id = cast(#{sessionId} as uuid) and is_active = true
